title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
title_zh: Web$hell：智能体网络访问的统一接口

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models , including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web$hell , an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract , WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects . These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

paragraphs.en: Existing research has approached this problem through different access models . Search-augmented agents ( Li et al., 2025a ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) operate through search APIs and cleaned text, while browser-based agents ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Chae et al., 2025 ) operate through page observations and actions. More recently, filesystem-based methods ( Liu et al., 2026 ) have enabled agents to store web documents and selectively inspect their contents through shell operations (e.g., grep , read ), reducing the need to read the entire contents. For the most part, these lines of work have made substantial progress within their respective access models. However, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, agents are increasingly required to perform multiple forms of web access within a single trajectory. For example, a shopping query may require an agent to discover relevant products, navigate pagination to find reviews, and retain useful information for later comparison. Yet these capabilities have largely been developed through separate access models, motivating a rethinking of how they can be integrated for agentic web access.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究通过不同的访问模型来处理这一问题。 搜索增强型智能体（Li et al., 2025a；Jin et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025）通过搜索 API 和清理后的文本运行，而基于浏览器的智能体（Zhou et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025；Chae et al., 2025）则通过页面观察和操作运行。 近期，基于文件系统的方案（Liu et al., 2026）使智能体能够存储网络文档，并通过 shell 操作（例如 grep、read）选择性检查其内容，从而减少读取全部内容的必要性。 总体而言，这些研究在其各自的访问模型中取得了显著进展。 然而，由于用户期望智能体能够完成长期、端到端的任务，智能体越来越需要在单个轨迹中执行多种形式的网络访问。 例如，一个购物查询可能需要智能体发现相关产品、通过分页导航查找评论，并保留有用信息以便后续比较。 但这些能力大多是通过独立的访问模型发展而来的，这促使我们重新思考如何将这些能力整合到智能体的网络访问过程中。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, this paper begins by investigating how well existing access models generalize across web search and web navigation, two representative types of web tasks. The key bottleneck is that each access model supports certain capabilities at the expense of others. We find that (i) search-augmented and filesystem-based agents struggle with web navigation since clean-text representations often omit page controls, while browser-based agents are less effective at broad information gathering due to their lengthy, noisy observations; (ii) combining search and browser-based access broadens task coverage but incurs substantial costs from repeated webpage interpretation; and (iii) adding filesystem-based capabilities such as grep reduces these costs. However, selective inspection can miss the context needed to use page controls, degrading web navigation performance.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本文首先研究了现有的访问模型在网页搜索和网页导航这两种典型的网络任务中泛化能力的强弱。 关键瓶颈在于，每种访问模型在支持某些功能的同时，也会牺牲其他功能。 我们发现：（i）结合搜索功能和文件系统的智能体在处理网页导航时存在困难，因为纯文本表示通常会忽略页面控件；而基于浏览器的智能体则因观察内容冗长且充满噪声，导致广泛信息收集效果不佳；（ii）结合搜索和浏览器访问方式虽然能扩大任务覆盖范围，但重复解析网页会引发高昂的成本；（iii）加入 grep 等基于文件系统的功能可以降低这些成本。 然而，选择性检查可能会遗漏使用页面控件所需的上下文信息，从而降低网页导航性能。

paragraphs.en: Together, these findings highlight three requirements for integrating the capabilities of existing access models. First, operability requires supporting both efficient information gathering and effective webpage interaction. Second, consistency calls for unifying webpage representations under common schemas, reducing the need to reinterpret the same page. Finally, persistence requires retaining retrieved web documents for selective access, lowering cost while preserving operability.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现共同揭示了整合现有访问模型能力所需的三个要求。 首先，可操作性需要同时支持高效的信息收集与有效的网页交互。 其次，一致性要求将网页表示统一在共同的架构下，从而减少重复解释同一页面的必要性。 最后，持久性要求保留检索到的网络文档以实现选择性访问，从而在保持操作性的同时降低成本。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present Web$hell , an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Our key idea is to provide agents with an intermediary that standardizes webpage representations and browser actions. Instead of coordinating separate access models, agents interact with Web$hell through a request-response loop. Specifically, WebContract defines how information and available actions are represented as objects, organized into pages, and accessed through shared operations. Each object combines a value , an address , and associations that preserve its context and references to related objects. Following this contract, WebCompiler transforms live webpages into structured representations using deterministic rules derived from HTML semantics. WebCache then retains the compiled pages for selective access and reuse throughout a task. Importantly, Web$hell allows agents to use object addresses to specify which information to inspect or which action to execute in subsequent requests. The interface then carries out the requested operation on the agent’s behalf and returns the outcome, thereby enabling unified agentic web access.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 Web$hell——一个将网页访问统一在单一访问模型下的接口。 我们的核心思路是为智能体提供一个中介，以标准化网页表示和浏览器操作。 智能体无需协调多个独立的访问模型，而是通过请求-响应循环与 Web$hell 进行交互。 具体而言，WebContract 定义了如何将信息和可用操作表示为对象，组织成页面，并通过共享操作进行访问。 每个对象都包含一个值、一个地址以及关联关系，用以保留其上下文和对相关对象的引用。 遵循该协议，WebCompiler 利用源自 HTML 语义的确定性规则，将实时网页转换为结构化表示。 随后，WebCache 会保留这些已编译的页面，以便在整个任务中按需访问和重复使用。 重要的是，Web$hell 允许智能体通过对象地址指定在后续请求中需要检查的信息或要执行的操作。 该接口会代表智能体执行所请求的操作并返回结果，从而实现统一的智能体网页访问。

paragraphs.en: We conduct extensive experiments on six benchmarks spanning web search, web navigation, and deep research. Notably, Web$hell achieves the highest task performance on all six benchmarks at comparable or lower cost. Our analyses suggest that an effective web interface should make clear how webpage elements relate to one another. These connections help agents gather more evidence, make browser actions more intuitive, and potentially guide exploration beyond the content already inspected. We further show that Web$hell remains robust to irrelevant content and maintains its efficiency as retrieved documents accumulate. Together, these findings demonstrate Web$hell ’s effectiveness across complex, information-intensive web tasks. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖网络搜索、网页浏览和深度研究的六个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验。 值得注意的是，Web$hell 在全部六个基准数据集上都实现了最高的任务性能，且成本相当或更低。 我们的分析表明，一个有效的网页界面应能清晰展示网页元素之间的相互关系。 这些关联有助于智能体收集更多证据，使浏览器操作更直观，并可能引导探索超出已检查内容之外的信息。 我们还证明，Web$hell 对无关内容具有鲁棒性，并且随着检索到的文档积累，其效率依然保持稳定。 综合来看，这些发现证明了 Web$hell 在复杂且信息密集的网络任务中的有效性。 我们的贡献如下：

sents.zh: 我们的分析表明，一个有效的网页界面应能清晰展示网页元素之间的相互关系。

sents.en: These connections help agents gather more evidence, make browser actions more intuitive, and potentially guide exploration beyond the content already inspected.
sents.zh: 这些关联有助于智能体收集更多证据，使浏览器操作更直观，并可能引导探索超出已检查内容之外的信息。

sents.en: We further show that Web$hell remains robust to irrelevant content and maintains its efficiency as retrieved documents accumulate.
sents.zh: 我们还证明，Web$hell 对无关内容具有鲁棒性，并且随着检索到的文档积累，其效率依然保持稳定。

sents.en: Together, these findings demonstrate Web$hell ’s effectiveness across complex, information-intensive web tasks.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现证明了 Web$hell 在复杂且信息密集的网络任务中的有效性。

sents.en: Our contributions are as follows:
sents.zh: 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify the need for unified agentic web access, investigating the limitations of existing access models and the challenges of integrating their capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到统一智能体网络访问的必要性，并研究了现有访问模型的局限性以及整合其功能所面临的挑战。

paragraphs.en: We propose Web$hell , an interface that provides consistent, operable, and persistent web access, enabling agents to handle diverse web tasks under a single access model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Web$hell，这是一个能够提供一致、可用且持久的网络访问的接口，使智能体能够在单一访问模型下处理各种网络任务。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that Web$hell achieves strong task performance and high efficiency across diverse web tasks, providing insights to guide future research on agentic web access.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，Web$hell 在各种网络任务中均能实现强大的任务表现和高效率，并为未来关于智能体网络访问的研究提供了指导性的见解。

paragraphs.en: Research on web-capable agents has advanced both information seeking and web navigation. Search-augmented agents interleave web search with reasoning ( Li et al., 2025a ; Jin et al., 2025 ) , while browser-based agents use page observations to guide their actions ( He et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . More recently, inspired by direct corpus interaction ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , a complementary line of research has explored filesystem-based web access, where webpages are fetched into persistent workspaces and selectively inspected with shell operations ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Open-source software such as CLI-Anything Browser ( Yang et al., 2026 ) has also adopted a similar approach, supporting web navigation by applying shell operations to the accessibility tree of a webpage. Nevertheless, these lines of work have largely developed web search and web navigation within separate access models. Web$hell unifies their capabilities at the interface level, standardizing web access through common representations and operations.
paragraphs.zh: 关于具备网络能力的智能体的研究推动了信息检索和网络导航的进步。 搜索增强型智能体将网络搜索与推理交替进行（Li et al., 2025a; Jin et al., 2025），而基于浏览器的智能体则利用页面观察结果来指导其操作（He et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2024）。 近期，受直接语料库交互的启发（Li et al., 2026; Zhuang et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2026），另一条互补的研究路线探索了基于文件系统的网络访问方式：将网页获取到持久化的工作空间中，并通过 shell 操作进行选择性检查（Liu et al., 2026）。 像 CLI-Anything Browser（Yang et al., 2026）这样的开源软件也采用了类似方法，通过对网页的可访问性树执行 shell 操作来实现网络导航。 然而，这些研究路线在很大程度上是在独立的访问模型中分别发展网络搜索和网络导航能力的。 Web$hell 在接口层面统一了这些能力，通过通用表示和操作标准化了网络访问。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on agent-computer interfaces ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and model harnesses ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) has established interface design as an important research problem for improving agent performance. On the web, this perspective initially took the form of simplifying webpage representations, including element filtering and DOM pruning ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Subsequent work ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Kwon and Lee, 2026 ; Hwang et al., 2026 ) has moved toward enhancing page representations, organizing webpage elements into regions or summaries that support targeted interaction. Yet these approaches require additional model inference or extensive offline traversal, limiting their practicality for open-web access. Alternatively, WebMCP and NLWeb ( Steiner et al., 2026 ) place the responsibility for interface design on website providers, who encapsulate site-specific functions and content for agents. These works share the premise that interfaces should help agents access and use the web ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , but each applies this premise within a limited scope. Web$hell extends it toward general web access, providing agents with an operable, consistent, and persistent interface.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于智能体-计算机接口（Yang et al., 2024）和模型利用方法（Lee et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026; Jiang et al., 2026）的研究，已将接口设计确立为提升智能体性能的重要研究问题。 在网页领域，这一视角最初表现为简化网页表示，包括元素过滤和DOM剪枝（Yang et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026）。 后续研究（Lee et al., 2025; Kwon and Lee, 2026; Hwang et al., 2026）则转向增强网页表示，将网页元素组织为支持目标交互的区域或摘要。 然而，这些方法需要额外的模型推理或大规模的离线遍历，限制了其在开放网页访问中的实用性。 作为替代方案，WebMCP和NLWeb（Steiner et al., 2026）将接口设计的责任交给了网站提供商，由他们为智能体封装特定网站的功能和内容。 这些研究都基于一个共同前提：接口应帮助智能体访问和使用网页（Zhong et al., 2026），但每项研究都在有限范围内应用了这一前提。 Web$hell将这一前提扩展到通用网页访问，为智能体提供了一个可操作、一致且持久的接口。

paragraphs.en: To understand how web access should be designed for LLM agents, we first analyze the capabilities and limitations of existing access models. Specifically, our analysis addresses two questions:
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解如何为大型语言模型智能体设计网络访问方式，我们首先分析现有访问模型的能力与局限性。 具体来说，我们的分析将探讨两个问题：

sents.en: To understand how web access should be designed for LLM agents, we first analyze the capabilities and limitations of existing access models.
sents.zh: 为了理解如何为大型语言模型智能体设计网络访问方式，我们首先分析现有访问模型的能力与局限性。

sents.en: Specifically, our analysis addresses two questions:
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们的分析将探讨两个问题：

paragraphs.en: Question I: How well do existing access models generalize across web tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 问题 I：现有的访问模型在不同网络任务中的泛化能力如何？

paragraphs.en: Question II: What limitations remain when access models are combined?
paragraphs.zh: 问题二：当访问模型被结合使用时，仍存在哪些局限性？

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We consider two types of web tasks: web search and web navigation. We use WideSearch ( Wong et al., 2026 ) for web search, which requires broad information gathering to populate tables, and WebArena-Verified ( hattami et al., 2025 ) for web navigation, which requires deeper, multi-step website interaction (e.g., reordering products). We randomly sample 100 queries from each benchmark and report item-level F1 for WideSearch and success rate for WebArena-Verified.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们考虑两种类型的网络任务：网络搜索和网络导航。 对于网络搜索，我们使用 WideSearch（Wong 等人，2026），该任务需要广泛收集信息来填充表格；对于网络导航，我们使用 WebArena-Verified（hattami 等人，2025），该任务需要更深入的多步骤网站交互（例如，重新排列产品）。 我们从每个基准测试中随机抽取 100 条查询，并报告 WideSearch 的项目级 F1 分数以及 WebArena-Verified 的成功率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three families of agents with different web access models (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了三种具有不同网络访问模型的智能体家族（表1）。

paragraphs.en: Search-augmented Agents . These agents primarily address web search tasks using search APIs and clean-text representations of webpages. Fetch-and-Read directly reads webpages returned by a web search. Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) uses its Reason-in-Documents module to summarize relevant information from these pages, while WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) uses an explorer agent to browse deeper into websites for additional information.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索增强型智能体。 这些智能体主要通过搜索 API 和网页的纯文本表示来解决网络搜索任务。 Fetch-and-Read 直接读取网络搜索返回的网页。 Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）利用其“文档内推理”模块从这些页面中总结相关信息，而 WebThinker（Li 等人，2025b）则使用一个探索型智能体深入浏览网站以获取更多信息。

paragraphs.en: We report cross-task performance of navigation-oriented agents on WideSearch and search-oriented agents on WebArena-Verified, using the other group’s average performance on each benchmark as a reference (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了导航型智能体在 WideSearch 上的跨任务表现，以及搜索型智能体在 WebArena-Verified 上的表现，并以另一组智能体在每个基准测试上的平均表现作为参考（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: We find that agents consistently fall below the corresponding reference average outside their primary task setting. These cross-task performance gaps can be partly explained by how each access model presents webpages to the agent. Clean-text observations are well suited for gathering information across many pages. However, text extraction can discard the structure and attributes needed to use controls such as buttons and input fields, limiting support for browser interaction. Although URL-based fetching supports limited navigation by allowing agents to follow links, it does not enable them to operate these controls. Browser observations preserve interactive elements, but their length and noise can consume substantial context when gathering information across many sources.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，智能体在其主要任务设置之外的表现始终低于相应的参考平均值。 这些跨任务的性能差异部分可以归因于每种访问模型向智能体呈现网页的方式。 纯文本观察非常适合从多个页面中收集信息。 然而，文本提取可能会丢弃使用按钮和输入字段等控件所需的结构和属性，从而限制对浏览器交互的支持。 虽然基于 URL 的获取方式允许智能体跟随链接以实现有限的导航，但它无法让智能体操作这些控件。 浏览器观察保留了交互式元素，但其长度和噪声在从多个来源收集信息时可能会消耗大量上下文。

sents.zh: 我们发现，智能体在其主要任务设置之外的表现始终低于相应的参考平均值。

sents.en: Clean-text observations are well suited for gathering information across many pages.
sents.zh: 纯文本观察非常适合从多个页面中收集信息。

sents.en: However, text extraction can discard the structure and attributes needed to use controls such as buttons and input fields, limiting support for browser interaction.
sents.zh: 然而，文本提取可能会丢弃使用按钮和输入字段等控件所需的结构和属性，从而限制对浏览器交互的支持。

sents.en: Although URL-based fetching supports limited navigation by allowing agents to follow links, it does not enable them to operate these controls.
sents.zh: 虽然基于 URL 的获取方式允许智能体跟随链接以实现有限的导航，但它无法让智能体操作这些控件。

sents.en: Browser observations preserve interactive elements, but their length and noise can consume substantial context when gathering information across many sources.
sents.zh: 浏览器观察保留了交互式元素，但其长度和噪声在从多个来源收集信息时可能会消耗大量上下文。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the findings in Analysis I, we first examine whether a hybrid access model can support both web search and web navigation tasks. We introduce Hybrid SB ( Search + Browser ), which provides clean text for information gathering and AXTrees with browsing tools for interaction. Hybrid SB performs comparably to the search-oriented average on WideSearch (66.0% vs. 65.8%) and exceeds the navigation-oriented average on WebArena-Verified (74.0% vs. 54.7%). However, it incurs substantially higher input token usage and LLM cost (Table 2 ). We observe that Hybrid SB repeatedly accesses the same source through both clean text and AXTrees for two purposes: (1) when the desired information is missing or unclear in one representation, agents use the other to find it. (2) agents cross-check page representations to verify their completeness. These repeated checks significantly increase the cost, indicating the need for a unified access model that reduces reliance on separate representations.
paragraphs.zh: 受分析 I 中研究结果的启发，我们首先考察混合访问模型是否能够同时支持网络搜索和网络导航任务。 我们提出了 Hybrid SB（搜索 + 浏览器），它通过提供干净的文本用于信息收集，并配备浏览工具以支持交互。 在 WideSearch 上，Hybrid SB 的表现与搜索导向的平均水平相当（66.0% vs. 65.8%）；而在 WebArena-Verified 上，其表现优于导航导向的平均水平（74.0% vs. 54.7%）。 然而，它带来了显著更高的输入令牌使用量和 LLM 成本（表 2）。 我们观察到，Hybrid SB 会反复通过干净文本和 AXTrees 访问同一来源，目的有两个：（1）当所需信息在一种表示中缺失或不清晰时，智能体便使用另一种表示来查找该信息。 （2）智能体通过交叉验证页面表示来确认其完整性。 这些重复的验证大幅增加了成本，表明需要一种统一的访问模型来减少对独立表示的依赖。

paragraphs.en: We next examine Hybrid SBF , which extends Hybrid SB with a filesystem workspace and shell operations. We observe that Hybrid SBF performs better at lower cost on WideSearch, where tasks require broad source coverage but only specific evidence from each source (Figure 2 , left). However, performance declines on WebArena-Verified (Figure 2 , right), where completing tasks requires identifying and using page controls. Selective inspection may reveal relevant text without showing how to interact with the page, causing agents to exhaust their turn budget searching for the required controls.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们研究 Hybrid SBF，它通过引入文件系统工作区和 shell 操作来扩展了 Hybrid SB。 我们观察到，在 WideSearch 任务中，Hybrid SBF 能以更低的成本取得更好的表现；这类任务需要广泛覆盖多个来源，但每个来源只需特定的证据（图 2，左侧）。 然而，在 WebArena-Verified 上其性能有所下降（图 2，右侧），因为完成这些任务需要识别并使用页面控件。 选择性检查可能会揭示相关文本，却无法展示如何与页面互动，导致智能体在寻找所需控件时耗尽回合配额。

paragraphs.en: Our analyses identify three requirements for agentic web access. Operability preserves the context needed for browser interaction while enabling efficient information gathering. Consistency calls for a common representation of information and browser actions, reducing repeated webpage interpretation. Persistence retains retrieved web documents for selective access, reducing the need to read pages in full. Together, these requirements guide the design of a unified web access model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析确定了智能体访问网页所需的三个要求。 可操作性在保持浏览器交互所需上下文的同时，实现了高效的信息收集。 一致性要求对信息和浏览器操作采用统一的表示方式，从而减少重复的网页解析。 持久性可保留已获取的网页文档以供选择性访问，减少了完整阅读页面的必要性。 这些要求共同指导了统一网页访问模型的设计。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce Web$hell , an interface for agents that unifies web access under a single access model. Specifically, our approach builds on three core components. (1) WebContract establishes common rules for representing and accessing webpages across websites. (2) WebCompiler compiles fetched webpages into operable representations that follow these rules. (3) WebCache preserves compiled webpages for selective and continued access throughout the task.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 Web$hell——一种为智能体设计的接口，它将网页访问统一到单一访问模型之下。 具体来说，我们的方法基于三个核心组件构建而成。 (1) WebContract 确立了跨网站表示和访问网页的通用规则。 (2) WebCompiler 将获取的网页编译为遵循这些规则的可操作表示形式。 (3) WebCache 保存已编译的网页，以便在整个任务中实现选择性、持续性的访问。

paragraphs.en: Given a user query, the agent interacts with Web$hell through the Request–Response loop illustrated in Figure 3 . Requests and responses follow the common rules defined by WebContract .
paragraphs.zh: 给定用户查询，智能体通过图 3 所示的请求-响应循环与 Web$hell 进行交互。 请求和响应遵循 WebContract 定义的共同规则。

paragraphs.en: Agent side. At each step, the agent considers its current context to determine what information or interaction it needs. It selects an operation (e.g., retrieve , grep , execute ) and sends a request. After receiving the response, it chooses its next request or produces a final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体侧。 在每个步骤中，智能体会根据当前上下文判断自身需要哪些信息或互动。 它会选择一个操作（例如：检索、grep、执行）并发送请求。 收到响应后，它会决定下一步的请求，或生成最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Interface side. The interface carries out the requested operation on the agent’s behalf. For retrieve , it searches the web, fetches the top-ranked webpages, and captures their current states. WebCompiler then compiles each captured webpage into information objects that represent its content and action objects that describe its available browser actions. It organizes these objects into a common file structure following WebContract , providing the agent with a consistent view across websites. Each compiled page is assigned a page address and stored in WebCache for subsequent requests. For grep , the interface locates matching content within these cached pages. For execute , it invokes the specified action object to perform the corresponding interaction on the live webpage. Updated page states are compiled and reflected in WebCache , while earlier states are kept read-only. The interface returns the requested information or execution outcome in its response.
paragraphs.zh: 接口端。 接口代表智能体执行所请求的操作。 对于 retrieve 操作，它会搜索网络、获取排名最高的网页，并捕获这些网页的当前状态。 随后，WebCompiler 将每个捕获到的网页编译为信息对象（表示其内容）和行动对象（描述其可用的浏览器操作）。 它按照 WebContract 将这些对象组织成统一的文件结构，使智能体能够以一致的方式查看不同网站的内容。 每个编译后的页面都会被分配一个页面地址，并存储在 WebCache 中，以备后续请求使用。 对于 grep 操作，接口会在这些已缓存的页面中查找匹配的内容。 对于 execute 操作，它会调用指定的行动对象，在实时网页上执行相应的交互。 更新后的页面状态会被编译并反映在 WebCache 中，而之前的状态则保持只读。 接口会在响应中返回所请求的信息或执行结果。

paragraphs.en: The first step in designing Web$hell is to determine what objects agents should operate on. Webpages encode content and controls in individual elements, but the context needed to interpret or use them may be encoded in separate elements. For example, a price entry is only meaningful together with the product name and option label, which may appear in separate elements. We therefore define an object as a unit of information or action with the following three properties.
paragraphs.zh: 设计 Web$hell 的第一步是确定智能体应操作哪些对象。 网页将内容和控件编码在单个元素中，但解释或使用这些内容所需的上下文可能编码在单独的元素中。 例如，价格条目只有与产品名称和选项标签一起才有意义，而这些信息可能出现在不同的元素中。 因此，我们将一个对象定义为具有以下三个属性的信息或操作单元。

paragraphs.en: This shared schema provides a consistent, addressable, and directly interpretable unit of interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 这种共享模式提供了一个一致、可寻址且可直接解释的交互单元。

paragraphs.en: The page schema defines a common file structure for representing a webpage. A unique page address identifies each fetched webpage as a whole. Each object has a unique local identifier within its page. This identifier is further combined with the page address to form its object address . Within each page, objects are organized into groups using a finite set of types, such as text, tables, links, and actions, grounded in HTML semantics. Text objects are further organized into sections based on the webpage’s heading structure. A table of contents lists the available object groups and shows how to access them. The detailed page schema is presented in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 页面模式定义了一种通用的文件结构，用于表示网页。 唯一的页面地址将每个获取到的网页作为一个整体进行标识。 每个对象在其页面内都有一个唯一的本地标识符。 该标识符会与页面地址进一步结合，形成其对象地址。 在每个页面中，对象会根据有限的类型（如文本、表格、链接和操作）组织成组，这些类型基于 HTML 语义学。 文本对象还会根据网页的标题结构进一步组织成多个部分。 目录会列出可用的对象组，并说明如何访问它们。 详细的页面模式在附录 C.1 中给出。

paragraphs.en: The operation schema defines how agents communicate with the interface through requests and responses . Information and action objects serve as the basic units of operation. An agent-to-interface request specifies an operation type, its arguments, and an object address when needed. An interface-to-agent response returns the outcome along with any resulting content and references. These common rules apply to operations such as retrieve , grep , read , and execute . The detailed operation schema and the list of operations are provided in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: WebCompiler applies deterministic rules derived from HTML semantics without relying on model inference. Tags and roles guide how element content and properties are compiled into an object’s value . Nesting and references indicate how elements are related, providing the associations needed to interpret that value. For example, a dropdown menu offers users several options to choose from. In HTML, the menu is defined by a <select> tag, with each choice specified by a nested <option> tag. The compiler represents this menu as an action object whose value specifies what the agent can do (select) and which options it can choose. The context for this action comes from the text in a <label> tag, such as “clothing size” . The compiler includes this context in the object’s association , indicating what the options represent. We implement these transformation rules as a finite set of constructors , which the compiler applies while traversing the captured DOM tree in document order. Constructors can recursively process nested elements, linking the resulting objects through references. When an element has no dedicated constructor, the compiler processes its text content and recursively applies the same transformation rules to nested elements. Text fragments separated by formatting tags are combined into a single text object.
paragraphs.zh: WebCompiler 应用源自 HTML 语义的确定性规则，而无需依赖模型推理。 标签和角色指导了元素内容和属性如何被编译为对象的值。 嵌套和引用表明了元素之间的关系，从而提供解释该值所需的关联信息。 例如，下拉菜单为用户提供多个可供选择的项目。 在 HTML 中，菜单由 <select> 标签定义，每个选项则由嵌套的 <option> 标签指定。 编译器将此菜单表示为一个动作对象，其值指明了智能体可以执行的操作（选择）以及可选择的选项。 该动作的上下文来自 <label> 标签中的文本，例如“服装尺码”。 编译器将此上下文包含在对象的关联中，以说明这些选项所代表的内容。 我们将这些转换规则实现为有限的一组构造函数，编译器在按文档顺序遍历捕获的 DOM 树时会应用这些构造函数。 构造函数可以递归处理嵌套元素，并通过引用将生成的对象连接起来。 当某个元素没有专用的构造函数时，编译器会处理其文本内容，并对嵌套元素递归应用相同的转换规则。 由格式标签分隔的文本片段会被合并为一个单一的文本对象。

paragraphs.en: Finally, WebCompiler organizes the resulting objects into a file tree following the page schema in WebContract , preserving references between related objects. paragraphs.en: After receiving web search results, the interface fetches the top-ranked webpages, compiles them, and stores the compiled pages in WebCache . Preparing these pages in advance provides three benefits. First, the interface reports failed fetches (e.g., 404 errors or CAPTCHA challenges), so the agent does not need to spend additional turns identifying these access failures. Second, the agent can get a quick overview of what each page offers without reading it in full. The compiler provides a table of contents showing the available object groups and how to access them. Third, operations support selective access to cached pages, allowing the agent to explore multiple webpages more efficiently and revisit them as the task progresses.
paragraphs.zh: 在收到网络搜索结果后，该接口会获取排名靠前的网页，将其整合，并将整合后的页面存储在 WebCache 中。 提前准备这些页面有三个好处。 首先，该接口会报告获取失败的情况（例如 404 错误或 CAPTCHA 验证挑战），因此智能体无需花费额外的轮次来识别这些访问失败问题。 其次，智能体可以在不阅读全文的情况下，快速了解每个页面的内容概要。 整合器会提供一个目录表，显示可用的对象组及其访问方式。 第三，该操作支持对缓存页面进行选择性访问，使智能体能够更高效地探索多个网页，并在任务推进过程中再次访问这些页面。

paragraphs.en: A core feature of Web$hell is that WebCache tracks page state changes while preserving access to earlier states. When the agent submits an execute request, the interface uses the connection retained during compilation to operate the corresponding control on the live webpage. If the action changes the webpage, the interface compiles the updated page state and caches it under a new page address. The action that produced the change is logged and reported to the agent in the response. The earlier state remains read-only, so its objects can still be inspected even when the corresponding actions are no longer available on the live webpage. This allows the agent to revisit past page states and review how the task progressed.
paragraphs.zh: Web$hell 的一个核心特性是，WebCache 在跟踪页面状态变化的同时，保留了访问早期状态的能力。 当智能体提交执行请求时，接口会利用编译期间保留的连接，对实时网页上的相应控件进行操作。 如果该操作改变了网页，接口就会将更新后的页面状态进行编译，并以新的页面地址将其缓存。 产生该变化的操作会被记录，并在响应中报告给智能体。 早期状态保持只读，因此即使实时网页上不再提供相应的操作，其对象仍然可以被检查。 这使得智能体能够重新访问过去的页面状态，并回顾任务的进展过程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Web$hell across three categories of web tasks: web search, web navigation, and deep research. Web search includes WideSearch ( Wong et al., 2026 ) , which requires collecting information across many sources into tables, and SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) , which features challenging questions with conflicting search results. For web navigation, we prioritize controlled evaluation settings. WebArena-Verified ( hattami et al., 2025 ) provides simulated environments to evaluate task completion under reproducible conditions, while WebWalkerQA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) requires browsing within the same domain from a given starting URL. For deep research, we cover research report writing in DeepResearchBench ( Du et al., 2026 ) and quantitative analysis of evidence in DeepWeb-Bench ( Xie et al., 2026 ) . For evaluation, we adopt the official metrics for each benchmark. Further benchmark details are available in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三类网络任务中评估 Web$hell：网络搜索、网络导航和深度研究。 网络搜索包括 WideSearch（Wong 等人，2026），该任务要求从多个来源收集信息并整理成表格；以及 SealQA（Pham 等人，2026），其特点是问题具有挑战性且搜索结果相互矛盾。 在网络导航方面，我们优先采用受控的评估设置。 WebArena-Verified（hattami 等人，2025）提供了模拟环境，用于在可复现的条件下评估任务完成情况；而 WebWalkerQA（Wu 等人，2025）则要求从给定的起始 URL 开始在相同域内进行浏览。 在深度研究方面，我们涵盖了 DeepResearchBench（Du 等人，2026）中的研究报告撰写任务，以及 DeepWeb-Bench（Xie 等人，2026）中的证据定量分析任务。 在评估中，我们采用各基准测试的官方指标。 更多基准测试细节见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: We mainly compare Web$hell with filesystem-based approaches, motivated by their competitive performance in our preliminary analysis (Section 3.2 ). We include: (1) Fetch-then-Explore (FtE) ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which stores cleaned webpage text in files for selective reading and revisit; (2) Hybrid SBF , a hybrid configuration that directly combines search, browser, and filesystem access. Additionally, we include (3) CLI-Anything Browser ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , a software tool for shell-based browsing over accessibility trees, as a practical alternative to research baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要将 Web$hell 与基于文件系统的方案进行比较，这是基于我们在初步分析（第 3.2 节）中发现它们具有竞争力的性能。 我们纳入以下方法：(1) Fetch-then-Explore (FtE)（Liu 等人，2026），该方法将清理后的网页文本存储为文件，以便选择性阅读和重新访问；(2) Hybrid SBF，一种直接结合搜索、浏览器和文件系统访问的混合配置。 此外，我们还纳入 (3) CLI-Anything Browser（Yang 等人，2026），这是一款基于外壳程序浏览可访问性树的软件工具，作为研究基线的一种实用替代方案。

paragraphs.en: On Web Search , Web$hell outperforms Fetch-then-Explore, the strongest baseline on both WideSearch and SealQA. This advantage may partly stem from how WebContract organizes content into common object types, such as body text, tables, and links, and defines consistent operations for accessing them across websites. This matters because agents must locate and revisit evidence across sources while building an answer. A common page organization gives them predictable locations to inspect, helping them direct subsequent requests to relevant content.
paragraphs.zh: 在网络搜索方面，Web$hell 在 WideSearch 和 SealQA 这两个数据集上都优于最强的基线模型 Fetch-then-Explore。 这种优势可能部分源于 WebContract 将内容组织为常见对象类型（如正文、表格和链接）的方式，并为跨网站访问这些内容定义了统一的操作方法。 这一点很重要，因为智能体在构建答案时必须定位并重新查看来自不同来源的证据。 统一的页面结构为他们提供了可预测的检查位置，有助于他们将后续请求引导至相关内容。

paragraphs.en: On Web Navigation , Hybrid SBF performs similarly to CLI-Anything Browser on WebArena-Verified, whereas Web$hell achieves the best performance. paragraphs.en: We observe that Web$hell achieves the highest evidence coverage on both web search benchmarks, measured by how much gold evidence is present in the agent’s context (Figure 5 ). To understand how it gathers more evidence, we conduct a case study comparing Web$hell with FtE, the strongest baseline on WideSearch (Figure 4 , left). The query asks for season award winners and their ratings across five football leagues. A core distinction is that Web$hell provides guidance for further inspection alongside the information it returns. FtE’s clean-text representation lists the “Premier League” but omits the season results required to answer the query, leading to additional web searches. In contrast, Web$hell presents the league as an information object, with references to related season data in its association field. These findings suggest that Web$hell facilitates further exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，Web$hell 在两个网络搜索基准测试中都实现了最高的证据覆盖度，该指标通过智能体上下文中包含的黄金证据量来衡量（图 5）。 为了了解它是如何收集更多证据的，我们对 Web$hell 与 FtE 进行了案例研究比较，其中 FtE 是 WideSearch 中最强的基线模型（图 4，左侧）。 该查询要求提供五个足球联赛的赛季奖项得主及其排名。 一个核心区别在于，Web$hell 在返回信息的同时，还提供了进一步探索的指导。 FtE 的纯文本表示中列出了“英超联赛”，但遗漏了回答查询所需的赛季结果，因此需要进行额外的网络搜索。 相比之下，Web$hell 将联赛作为一个信息对象呈现，并在其关联字段中引用了相关的赛季数据。 这些发现表明，Web$hell 有助于促进进一步的探索。

paragraphs.en: A key feature of Web$hell is that webpage controls are compiled into action objects with the context needed to interpret and use them. Figure 4 (right) illustrates this benefit in a task requiring an older article from a news archive. The agent can either search for the article directly through the search form or use load more to browse older entries. Hybrid SBF ’s observation, however, presents the form as an unlabeled text box and button, requiring the agent to reconstruct the context needed to understand and use it. Hybrid SBF instead repeatedly selects load more , exhausting its turn budget without finding the article. In contrast, WebCompiler preserves the label and query parameter in a self-contained action object, enabling Web$hell to use the site search and reach the article. This case illustrates how Web$hell supports web navigation by reducing the need to infer how controls work.
paragraphs.zh: Web$hell 的一个关键特性是，网页控件会被编译为动作对象，其中包含了解释和使用这些控件所需的上下文信息。 图 4（右侧）通过一个需要从新闻存档中查找旧文章的任务，展示了这一优势。 智能体既可以通过搜索表单直接查找该文章，也可以使用“加载更多”来浏览更旧的条目。 然而，混合 SBF 的观察结果却将表单呈现为一个无标签的文本框和按钮，要求智能体自行重建理解和使用它所需的上下文信息。 相反，混合 SBF 会反复选择“加载更多”，最终耗尽其回合配额却仍未找到文章。 相比之下，WebCompiler 将标签和查询参数保留在一个自包含的动作对象中，使 Web$hell 能够使用网站的搜索功能并定位到该文章。 这个案例说明了 Web$hell 如何通过减少推断控件运作方式的需求，来支持网页导航。

paragraphs.en: Web$hell presents information together with references to its associated actions, allowing agents to move directly from reading page content to interacting with it. For example, a grep result for Set status can provide the action reference needed to open the status dialog. To examine the benefit of this connection, we remove these references and require agents to obtain available actions from a separate listing. We observe that this separation consistently degrades performance and increases cost across the two web navigation benchmarks (Figure 6 ). Connecting information and actions within the interface thus plays an important role in task completion.
paragraphs.zh: Web$hell 将信息与其相关操作的引用一同呈现，使智能体能够直接从阅读页面内容过渡到与之交互。 例如，对“设置状态”执行 grep 操作的结果可以提供打开状态对话框所需的操作引用。 为了检验这种关联带来的益处，我们移除了这些引用，并要求智能体从单独的列表中获取可用操作。 我们观察到，在两个网页导航基准测试中，这种分离始终会导致性能下降并增加成本（图 6）。 因此，在界面中将信息与操作连接起来对于完成任务起着重要作用。

paragraphs.en: Web$hell remains robust to irrelevant information. To test robustness to irrelevant information, we manually inject 50 50 , 100 100 , 200 200 , or 400 400 distractor pages into Web$hell ’s WebCache . We find that Web$hell maintains largely stable accuracy and inference costs even as the amount of irrelevant information increases substantially (Figure 7 ). The baselines also maintain accuracy, but Fetch-then-Explore’s cost more than doubles and Hybrid SBF ’s rises steadily. Fetch-then-Explore often lists the entire workspace before selecting what to read, so the agent processes more file names as pages accumulate. Hybrid SBF often avoids this step by searching a fetched page directly with grep , using the file path returned by fetch . However, keeping track of these paths becomes harder as pages accumulate, and path errors sometimes lead the agent back to a full workspace listing. In contrast, Web$hell ’s page address system provides short references that agents can reuse in subsequent searches and reads, suggesting that reliable addressing helps selective access remain efficient as irrelevant content accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: Web$hell 对无关信息仍具有强大的鲁棒性。 为了测试其对无关信息的鲁棒性，我们手动向 Web$hell 的 WebCache 中注入 50、100、200 或 400 个干扰页面。 我们发现，即使无关信息的量大幅增加，Web$hell 的准确率和推理成本仍能基本保持稳定（图 7）。 基线模型也能保持准确率，但 Fetch-then-Explore 的成本翻了一倍多，而 Hybrid SBF 的成本则持续上升。 Fetch-then-Explore 在决定读取内容之前通常会列出整个工作区，因此随着页面数量增加，智能体需要处理的文件名也越来越多。 Hybrid SBF 通常通过直接使用 grep 搜索已获取的页面来避免这一步骤，并利用 fetch 返回的文件路径进行操作。 然而，随着页面数量增加，跟踪这些路径变得越来越困难，路径错误有时会导致智能体重新回到完整的工作区列表。 相比之下，Web$hell 的页面地址系统提供了简短的引用，智能体可以在后续搜索和读取中重复使用，这表明可靠的寻址机制有助于在无关内容积累时保持选择性访问的高效性。

These results support an interface that keeps a broad collection of sources accessible while allowing the agent to determine the scope of inspection. Web$hell supports this flexibility without substantially increasing inference cost across the tested settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 WideSearch 上调整每次搜索预取页面的数量（k ∈ {5, 7, 10}），以考察 Web$hell 如何处理不断增长的缓存。 性能仅有轻微变化，而平均推理成本几乎保持不变（图 8）。 即使有更多页面可用，智能体仍会继续检查一个大小相近的子集。 这些结果支持一种接口：该接口在保持大量来源可访问的同时，允许智能体自行决定检查范围。 Web$hell 支持这种灵活性，且在所有测试设置中并未显著增加推理成本。

sents.zh: 我们在 WideSearch 上调整每次搜索预取页面的数量（k ∈ {5, 7, 10}），以考察 Web$hell 如何处理不断增长的缓存。

sents.en: Performance varies modestly, while average inference cost remains nearly unchanged (Figure 8 ).
sents.zh: 性能仅有轻微变化，而平均推理成本几乎保持不变（图 8）。

sents.en: The agent continues to inspect a similarly sized subset even as more pages become available.
sents.zh: 即使有更多页面可用，智能体仍会继续检查一个大小相近的子集。

sents.en: These results support an interface that keeps a broad collection of sources accessible while allowing the agent to determine the scope of inspection.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持一种接口：该接口在保持大量来源可访问的同时，允许智能体自行决定检查范围。

sents.en: Web$hell supports this flexibility without substantially increasing inference cost across the tested settings.
sents.zh: Web$hell 支持这种灵活性，且在所有测试设置中并未显著增加推理成本。

paragraphs.en: This paper proposes Web$hell , a unified interface for agentic web access. It standardizes webpage information and actions as addressable objects, compiles live webpages into operable representations, and preserves them for selective and stateful access throughout a task. Our experiments demonstrate strong performance and efficiency across web search, web navigation, and deep research, while further analyses show the benefits of connecting information with associated actions and maintaining persistent, addressable access as retrieved content accumulates. We hope that Web$hell will contribute to future work on more effective interfaces for the agentic web.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 Web$hell，一个用于智能体访问网络的统一接口。 它将网页信息和操作标准化为可寻址的对象，将实时网页编译为可操作的表示形式，并在整个任务中保留这些表示，以实现选择性和状态化的访问。 我们的实验表明，Web$hell 在网络搜索、网络导航和深度研究方面表现出强大的性能和效率；进一步的分析显示，将信息与相关操作连接起来，并在检索内容不断积累时保持持久且可寻址的访问方式，能够带来显著优势。 我们希望 Web$hell 能为未来开发更高效的智能体网络接口工作做出贡献。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on six benchmarks covering web search, web navigation, and deep research. Together, they test information gathering across sources, interaction with websites, and synthesis of evidence into reports and quantitative answers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在六个基准测试上进行评估，这些测试涵盖网络搜索、网页导航和深度研究。 这些测试共同检验了跨来源的信息收集能力、与网站的互动能力，以及将证据整合成报告及定量答案的能力。

sents.en: We evaluate on six benchmarks covering web search, web navigation, and deep research.
sents.zh: 我们在六个基准测试上进行评估，这些测试涵盖网络搜索、网页导航和深度研究。

sents.zh: 这些测试共同检验了跨来源的信息收集能力、与网站的互动能力，以及将证据整合成报告及定量答案的能力。

paragraphs.en: WideSearch ( Wong et al., 2026 ) evaluates broad information gathering across webpages. Agents find entities that meet a query’s conditions and collect their attributes in a table. The benchmark contains 100 English and 100 Chinese queries. We report item-level F1 by comparing generated tables with reference tables. We follow the benchmark’s column-specific evaluation criteria, using rule-based checks for exact matches, numerical tolerances, dates, and URLs, and gpt-5.6-luna for columns requiring semantic judgments. The same model also aligns differently worded entity names before row matching.
paragraphs.zh: WideSearch（Wong 等人，2026）评估跨网页的广泛信息收集能力。 智能体能够找到满足查询条件的实体，并将其属性收集到表格中。 该基准测试包含 100 条英文查询和 100 条中文查询。 我们通过将生成的表格与参考表格进行比较，报告项目级别的 F1 分数。 我们遵循该基准测试的特定列评估标准：对精确匹配、数值容差、日期和 URL 使用基于规则的检查，而对需要语义判断的列则使用 gpt-5.6-luna。 同一模型在行匹配前也会对齐措辞不同的实体名称。

sents.zh: WideSearch（Wong 等人，2026）评估跨网页的广泛信息收集能力。

sents.zh: 我们通过将生成的表格与参考表格进行比较，报告项目级别的 F1 分数。

paragraphs.en: SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) focuses on questions with conflicting, misleading, or incomplete search results. Answering them requires resolving ambiguity or combining evidence across sources. We evaluate all 254 questions in Seal-Hard and report answer accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: SealQA（Pham 等人，2026）专注于那些搜索结果存在冲突、具有误导性或不完整的问题。 回答这些问题需要消除歧义或整合来自不同来源的证据。 我们对 Seal-Hard 中全部 254 个问题进行了评估，并报告了答案的准确率。

sents.en: SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) focuses on questions with conflicting, misleading, or incomplete search results.
sents.zh: SealQA（Pham 等人，2026）专注于那些搜索结果存在冲突、具有误导性或不完整的问题。

sents.zh: 回答这些问题需要消除歧义或整合来自不同来源的证据。

sents.en: We evaluate all 254 questions in Seal-Hard and report answer accuracy.
sents.zh: 我们对 Seal-Hard 中全部 254 个问题进行了评估，并报告了答案的准确率。

paragraphs.en: WebArena-Verified ( hattami et al., 2025 ) provides reproducible, self-hosted websites for controlled evaluation of web interaction. Tasks involve finding information, navigating between pages, and modifying content on shopping sites, discussion forums, and other web applications. The benchmark contains 812 tasks, but 23 could not be reproduced because the required Wikipedia corpus could not be downloaded. Our evaluation therefore covers 789 tasks. We report task success rate using the benchmark’s deterministic evaluator, which checks final responses and recorded interactions against task-specific completion criteria.
paragraphs.zh: WebArena-Verified（hattami 等人，2025）为受控的网页交互评估提供了可复现且可自托管的网站。 任务包括在购物网站、讨论论坛和其他网页应用中查找信息、在不同页面间导航以及修改内容。 该基准包含 812 项任务，但由于无法下载所需的维基百科语料库，其中 23 项任务未能复现。 因此，我们的评估涵盖了 789 项任务。 我们使用该基准的确定性评估器报告任务成功率，该评估器会将最终响应和记录下来的交互与特定任务的完成标准进行比对。

sents.zh: WebArena-Verified（hattami 等人，2025）为受控的网页交互评估提供了可复现且可自托管的网站。

paragraphs.en: WebWalkerQA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) evaluates evidence gathering through navigation from a given starting URL. Questions range from locating evidence on one subpage to combining information across multiple subpages. We exclude questions whose reference pages are inaccessible or no longer contain the evidence for the gold answer after website updates. We report answer accuracy on the remaining 420 questions.
paragraphs.zh: WebWalkerQA（Wu 等人，2025）通过从给定起始 URL 开始导航来评估证据收集过程。 问题范围涵盖在单个子页面上定位证据，到整合多个子页面上的信息。 我们排除那些参考页面无法访问，或在网站更新后不再包含标准答案所需证据的问题。 我们对剩余的 420 个问题报告了回答准确率。

sents.en: WebWalkerQA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) evaluates evidence gathering through navigation from a given starting URL.
sents.zh: WebWalkerQA（Wu 等人，2025）通过从给定起始 URL 开始导航来评估证据收集过程。

sents.en: Questions range from locating evidence on one subpage to combining information across multiple subpages.
sents.zh: 问题范围涵盖在单个子页面上定位证据，到整合多个子页面上的信息。

sents.zh: 我们排除那些参考页面无法访问，或在网站更新后不再包含标准答案所需证据的问题。

sents.en: We report answer accuracy on the remaining 420 questions.
sents.zh: 我们对剩余的 420 个问题报告了回答准确率。

paragraphs.en: DeepResearchBench ( Du et al., 2026 ) contains 100 tasks that require agents to synthesize web evidence into research reports. We report RACE Overall, which compares generated and reference reports across comprehensiveness, insight/depth, instruction following, and readability. An LLM judge applies task-specific criteria and weights to both reports. The overall score ranges from 0 to 1, with 0.5 indicating equal scores for the generated and reference reports.
paragraphs.zh: DeepResearchBench（Du 等人，2026）包含 100 项任务，要求智能体将网络证据整合成研究报告。 我们报告了 RACE Overall，该指标通过全面性、洞察力/深度、指令遵循性和可读性等方面对生成的报告与参考报告进行比较。 一个 LLM 评判器会依据任务特定的标准和权重对两份报告进行评估。 总分为 0 到 1，其中 0.5 表示生成的报告与参考报告的得分相等。

sents.en: DeepResearchBench ( Du et al., 2026 ) contains 100 tasks that require agents to synthesize web evidence into research reports.
sents.zh: DeepResearchBench（Du 等人，2026）包含 100 项任务，要求智能体将网络证据整合成研究报告。

sents.zh: 我们报告了 RACE Overall，该指标通过全面性、洞察力/深度、指令遵循性和可读性等方面对生成的报告与参考报告进行比较。

sents.zh: 总分为 0 到 1，其中 0.5 表示生成的报告与参考报告的得分相等。

paragraphs.en: DeepWeb-Bench ( Xie et al., 2026 ) contains 100 tasks requiring quantitative analysis across sources. Agents gather evidence and derive quantities to compare eight entities across eight analytical dimensions. An LLM judge evaluates each cell against a reference answer and a task-specific rubric, which allows partial credit and specifies when information should be reported as unavailable. We report the overall rubric score on a 0–100 scale.
paragraphs.zh: DeepWeb-Bench（Xie 等人，2026）包含 100 项需要跨来源进行定量分析的任务。 智能体收集证据并推导出数量值，以在八个分析维度上比较八个实体。 一个 LLM 裁判根据参考答案和任务特定的评分标准评估每个单元格，该评分标准允许给予部分分数，并规定了信息应何时被报告为不可用。 我们在 0–100 的尺度上报告整体的评分标准得分。

sents.en: DeepWeb-Bench ( Xie et al., 2026 ) contains 100 tasks requiring quantitative analysis across sources.
sents.zh: DeepWeb-Bench（Xie 等人，2026）包含 100 项需要跨来源进行定量分析的任务。

sents.en: Agents gather evidence and derive quantities to compare eight entities across eight analytical dimensions.
sents.zh: 智能体收集证据并推导出数量值，以在八个分析维度上比较八个实体。

paragraphs.en: The preliminary comparison covers search-augmented, filesystem-based, and browser-based agents. The main comparison includes Fetch-then-Explore, CLI-Anything Browser, and Hybrid SBF .
paragraphs.zh: 初步比较涵盖了搜索增强型、文件系统型和浏览器型智能体。 主要比较包括“先获取后探索”、CLI-Anything 浏览器和混合 SBF。

sents.en: The preliminary comparison covers search-augmented, filesystem-based, and browser-based agents.
sents.zh: 初步比较涵盖了搜索增强型、文件系统型和浏览器型智能体。

sents.en: The main comparison includes Fetch-then-Explore, CLI-Anything Browser, and Hybrid SBF .
sents.zh: 主要比较包括“先获取后探索”、CLI-Anything 浏览器和混合 SBF。

paragraphs.en: Fetch-and-Read follows a naive search-and-read approach, fetching retrieved webpages and passing their text directly to the agent. The agent reads the returned text and searches for further evidence as needed.
paragraphs.zh: “获取-阅读”方法遵循一种简单的搜索-阅读策略，即获取检索到的网页，并将其文本直接传递给智能体。 智能体会读取返回的文本，并在需要时进一步搜索证据。

sents.en: Fetch-and-Read follows a naive search-and-read approach, fetching retrieved webpages and passing their text directly to the agent.
sents.zh: “获取-阅读”方法遵循一种简单的搜索-阅读策略，即获取检索到的网页，并将其文本直接传递给智能体。

sents.en: The agent reads the returned text and searches for further evidence as needed.
sents.zh: 智能体会读取返回的文本，并在需要时进一步搜索证据。

paragraphs.en: Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) processes retrieved passages with its Reason-in-Documents module. Given the search query and the reasoning so far, this module extracts relevant information and returns it to the main agent for further reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）通过其“文档内推理”模块处理检索到的段落。 根据搜索查询和目前的推理过程，该模块会提取相关信息并将其返回给主智能体以进行进一步推理。

sents.en: Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) processes retrieved passages with its Reason-in-Documents module.
sents.zh: Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）通过其“文档内推理”模块处理检索到的段落。

paragraphs.en: WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) delegates information gathering to a Deep Web Explorer. The explorer can issue further searches and open additional pages before returning its findings to the main agent.
paragraphs.zh: WebThinker（Li 等人，2025b）将信息收集任务委托给一个深度网络探索器。 该探索器可以在返回其发现结果给主智能体之前，执行进一步的搜索并打开额外的页面。

sents.en: WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) delegates information gathering to a Deep Web Explorer.
sents.zh: WebThinker（Li 等人，2025b）将信息收集任务委托给一个深度网络探索器。

sents.en: The explorer can issue further searches and open additional pages before returning its findings to the main agent.

paragraphs.en: Fetch-then-Explore ( Liu et al., 2026 ) saves fetched webpages as cleaned text in a persistent filesystem workspace. The agent uses grep to locate relevant passages and read to inspect them, and can revisit saved pages later in the task.
paragraphs.zh: Fetch-then-Explore（Liu 等人，2026）将获取的网页以清理后的文本形式存储在持久化文件系统的作业空间中。 智能体使用 grep 定位相关段落并通过阅读进行检验，并且可以在任务后续阶段重新访问已保存的页面。

sents.en: Fetch-then-Explore ( Liu et al., 2026 ) saves fetched webpages as cleaned text in a persistent filesystem workspace.
sents.zh: Fetch-then-Explore（Liu 等人，2026）将获取的网页以清理后的文本形式存储在持久化文件系统的作业空间中。

paragraphs.en: CLI-Anything Browser is an open-source tool for shell-based web interaction. We include it to compare a browser-oriented tool with Web$hell ’s unified interface for information seeking and interaction across webpages.
paragraphs.zh: CLI-Anything Browser 是一款基于命令行的网页交互开源工具。 我们将其纳入比较，以对比这款浏览器导向型工具与 Web$hell 在跨网页信息检索和交互方面的统一界面。

paragraphs.en: We use gpt-5.6-luna as the main-agent model for all methods, with reasoning effort set to high . For established baselines, we use prompts from their original implementations, adapted to the benchmark instructions and available tools. All methods receive the same main-agent turn budget within each task category, with 100 turns for Web Search, 50 for Web Navigation, and 200 for Deep Research. We apply a 75-second page-access timeout and a 60-minute execution limit per task across methods. Methods with web-search access use Serper † † † https://serper.dev/ . For recoverable browser-loading failures, we fall back to a direct HTTP request to retrieve the document. Error pages and CAPTCHA challenges are reported as access failures rather than treated as page evidence. To prevent answer leakage, we exclude benchmark pages containing reference answers, including those hosted on Hugging Face, from search results and page access.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法均使用 gpt-5.6-luna 作为主智能体模型，并将推理强度设为高。 对于已确立的基线方法，我们采用其原始实现中的提示词，并根据基准测试说明和可用工具进行调整。 在每一类任务中，所有方法共享相同的主智能体轮次预算：网络搜索为 100 轮，网页导航为 50 轮，深度研究为 200 轮。 所有方法均对每个任务应用 75 秒的页面访问超时限制和 60 分钟的执行时间上限。 具备网络搜索功能的方法使用 Serper † † † https://serper.dev/。 对于可恢复的浏览器加载失败，我们转而采用直接 HTTP 请求来获取文档。 错误页面和 CAPTCHA 验证挑战将被报告为访问失败，而非作为页面证据处理。 为防止答案泄露，我们将包含参考答案的基准测试页面（包括托管在 Hugging Face 上的页面）排除在搜索结果和页面访问之外。

paragraphs.en: We randomly sample 100 tasks from each of WideSearch and WebArena-Verified for the preliminary analysis. Our comparison examines whether the designs developed for information seeking remain effective when tasks also require browser interaction. For WebArena-Verified, we provide search-oriented agents with the browser actions introduced in WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , including clicking, typing, scrolling, tab management, and page navigation. We preserve their clean-text observations because these representations are integral to how the methods gather and process web evidence. Adding accessibility trees would address a different question: whether extending those methods with browser-oriented observations improves navigation. We examine this extension through Hybrid SB in Analysis II.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为初步分析，从 WideSearch 和 WebArena-Verified 中各随机抽取 100 个任务。 我们的比较旨在考察：当任务同时需要浏览器交互时，为信息检索设计的方法是否仍然有效。 对于 WebArena-Verified，我们为以搜索为导向的智能体提供了 WebArena（Zhou et al., 2024）中引入的浏览器操作，包括点击、输入、滚动、标签页管理和页面导航。 我们保留了它们的纯文本观察结果，因为这些表示形式是这些方法收集和处理网络证据的关键组成部分。 加入可访问性树将涉及另一个问题：通过增加面向浏览器的观察信息来扩展这些方法，是否有助于改善导航能力。 我们将在分析 II 中通过 Hybrid SB 考察这种扩展方法。

paragraphs.en: We use per-call metrics to distinguish the context processed at each model invocation from the number of invocations needed to complete a task. This distinction matters because some baselines distribute work across a main agent and auxiliary planners or explorers. We include all such calls and divide their total input tokens and inference cost by the total number of LLM calls. We report mean input tokens per call and inference cost per 100 calls, with the latter scaled for readability. The resulting comparison captures the average inference burden across each method’s model calls, including work delegated to auxiliary modules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用每次调用的指标，将每次模型调用中处理的内容与完成任务所需的调用次数区分开来。 这种区分很重要，因为某些基线方法会将任务分配给主智能体和辅助规划器或探索器。 我们将所有此类调用都纳入统计，并将其总输入词元数和推理成本除以 LLM 调用的总数。 我们报告每次调用的平均输入词元数以及每 100 次调用的推理成本，其中后者经过缩放以方便阅读。 由此得出的比较反映了每种方法模型调用中的平均推理负担，包括分配给辅助模块的工作。

paragraphs.en: We use evidence coverage to assess how effectively an interface helps the agent access the information needed to answer a question. Using each benchmark’s reference answers as the gold information, we check how much of that information appears in the tool responses exposed to the agent during task execution. This distinction matters for interfaces that store webpages for selective reading. Relevant information may be present in the workspace without ever reaching the agent’s context. We therefore count only the content actually returned to the agent, including passages retrieved through grep or read . On WideSearch, coverage is the fraction of required reference-table cells whose values appear in this content. On SealQA, it is the fraction of questions whose reference answer appears. Each reference item is counted once, regardless of repeated exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用证据覆盖度来评估界面在帮助智能体获取回答问题所需信息方面的有效性。 我们将每个基准测试的参考答案作为标准信息，检查这些信息在执行任务期间呈现给智能体的工具响应中出现了多少。 对于存储网页以供选择性阅读的系统而言，这种区别至关重要。 相关信息可能存在于工作区中，但从未进入智能体的上下文。 因此，我们只计算实际返回给智能体的内容，包括通过 grep 或 read 检索到的段落。 在 WideSearch 中，覆盖度是指所需参考表单元格中，其值出现在这些内容中的比例。 在 SealQA 中，它是指参考答案出现的提问比例。 每个参考项只计算一次，无论是否重复出现。

paragraphs.en: We examine which aspects of the unified interface contribute to Web$hell ’s effectiveness. The preliminary analysis motivates reducing the need to switch representations when moving from information gathering to browser interaction. This capability is supported jointly by WebContract , WebCompiler , and WebCache , which define, construct, and retain objects with their associated actions. Because these components operate on the same object schema, removing an entire component would alter several aspects of the interface together. We therefore focus on the references linking information objects to action objects, removing these references while retaining both types of objects and WebCache . Without these references, the agent must request a separate control listing to obtain executable identifiers. These identifiers remain valid until the page changes or another listing is requested. We compare task performance and LLM inference cost on 100 WebArena-Verified tasks and 100 WebWalkerQA questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究统一接口的哪些方面有助于 Web$hell 的有效性。 初步分析表明，有必要减少在从信息收集转向浏览器交互时切换表示形式的需要。 这一能力由 WebContract、WebCompiler 和 WebCache 共同支持，它们负责定义、构建并保留与其相关操作的对象。 由于这些组件基于相同的对象模式运行，移除整个组件将同时改变接口的多个方面。 因此，我们重点关注连接信息对象与操作对象的引用，在移除这些引用的同时保留这两类对象以及 WebCache。 没有这些引用，智能体必须请求单独的控制列表以获取可执行标识符。 这些标识符在页面变更或请求其他列表之前始终保持有效。 我们在 100 个 WebArena-Verified 任务和 100 个 WebWalkerQA 问题上比较了任务表现和 LLM 推理成本。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether agents can locate relevant information efficiently when unrelated pages accumulate in their workspace. For each SealQA run, we place 50 50 , 100 100 , 200 200 , or 400 400 distractor pages in Web$hell ’s initial WebCache and in the filesystem workspaces of Fetch-then-Explore and Hybrid SBF . These pages are available for inspection but are not inserted directly into the agent’s context. We measure answer accuracy and LLM inference cost at each noise level. We exclude CLI-Anything Browser because it exposes webpages through open browser tabs. Introducing distractors would therefore require additional browser tabs (e.g., 400 chrome tabs), rather than stored pages in a workspace. This experiment focuses on the latter setting.

paragraphs.en: WebContract specifies how information and actions are addressed, interpreted, and accessed. Every object has an address identifying it within a captured page, a value containing information or an action specification, and associations providing context or references to related objects. For example, a table cell retains its row and column labels, while a selection action retains its purpose and available inputs. Table 4 shows both objects on an illustrative clothing page.

paragraphs.en: HTML describes a webpage’s elements and their relationships, including headings, table cells, and input controls. WebCompiler traverses the captured document in order and applies a constructor for each supported element type. Constructors process nested elements recursively and preserve their relationships as associations. Elements without a dedicated constructor contribute their text and nested content to the containing section. The compiler then assigns file locations, connects references, and writes the page index without model inference.
paragraphs.zh: HTML 描述了网页的元素及其之间的关系，包括标题、表格单元格和输入控件。 WebCompiler 按顺序遍历捕获的文档，并为每个受支持的元素类型应用构造函数。 构造函数递归处理嵌套元素，并将其关系作为关联保存下来。 没有专用构造函数的元素会将其文本和嵌套内容贡献给包含它们的章节。 随后，编译器会分配文件位置、连接引用，并在没有模型推理的情况下编写页面索引。

paragraphs.en: Headings divide text into sections, while formatting such as boldface remains part of the surrounding text. Navigation, headers, and footers are stored separately when the page identifies these regions. For tables, the compiler accounts for cells spanning multiple rows or columns and associates each value with its row and column labels.
paragraphs.zh: 标题将文本划分为不同部分，而加粗等格式则仍属于周围文本的一部分。 当页面识别出这些区域时，导航栏、页眉和页脚会被单独存储。 对于表格，编译器会处理跨多行或多列的单元格，并将每个值与其行和列标签关联起来。

sents.zh: 标题将文本划分为不同部分，而加粗等格式则仍属于周围文本的一部分。

sents.en: Navigation, headers, and footers are stored separately when the page identifies these regions.
sents.zh: 当页面识别出这些区域时，导航栏、页眉和页脚会被单独存储。

paragraphs.en: A control is an interactive element, such as a button, text field, or selection menu. HTML and accessibility annotations called ARIA describe its type and label. The compiler combines these declarations with input options, current values, and constraints such as required fields. In the clothing example, the <label> references the <select> menu, connecting the purpose Clothing size to the selection action. Its nested <option> elements supply the displayed names and corresponding input values. For a form, related fields and their submission control become one action.
paragraphs.zh: 控件是一种交互式元素，例如按钮、文本框或选择菜单。 HTML 和名为 ARIA 的可访问性注释会描述其类型和标签。 编译器将这些声明与输入选项、当前值以及必填字段等约束条件相结合。 在服装示例中，<label> 引用了 <select> 菜单，将“服装尺码”这一用途与选择操作连接起来。 其嵌套的 <option> 元素提供了显示名称和对应的输入值。 对于表单而言，相关字段及其提交控件会合并为一个操作。

paragraphs.en: A webpage may receive records that are not all displayed on screen. The compiler also extracts structured data embedded in the page and text responses captured from the same origin during page loading. It organizes these data into facts or tables, retaining references to their source and related records.
paragraphs.zh: 网页可能会接收并非全部显示在屏幕上的记录。 编译器还会提取嵌入在页面中的结构化数据，以及页面加载期间从相同源捕获的文本响应。 它将这些数据组织成事实或表格，同时保留对其来源和相关记录的引用。

paragraphs.en: Individual fields can be much larger than the surrounding content; one vehicle-model field in a captured car-review page contains 1,767,349 characters. Table and metadata values longer than 2,000 characters are stored separately, with their addresses and lengths retained in the parent records. These large values can then be retrieved incrementally by requesting specific line or character ranges, while the complete value remains stored.

paragraphs.en: WebCache stores pages obtained through web search or opened directly by the agent, making them available throughout the task. For each search, the interface attempts to fetch the ranked results and returns an address for each stored page, along with any access failures. The agent can then search or read the compiled content without fetching the page again. Browser tabs may also remain open, allowing the agent to return to a page and interact with it after inspecting other pages. These tabs share the browser session’s cookies and local storage, while each stored page state has its own address.
paragraphs.zh: WebCache 存储通过网页搜索获取或由智能体直接打开的页面，使这些页面在整个任务期间均可使用。 每次搜索时，接口都会尝试获取排序后的结果，并为每个已存储的页面返回一个地址，同时报告任何访问失败的情况。 之后，智能体无需再次获取页面，即可搜索或阅读已整理的内容。 浏览器标签页也可能保持打开状态，使智能体在检查其他页面后能够返回到某个页面并进行交互。 这些标签页共享浏览器会话的 Cookie 和局部存储，而每个已存储页面的状态都有自己独立的地址。

sents.zh: WebCache 存储通过网页搜索获取或由智能体直接打开的页面，使这些页面在整个任务期间均可使用。

sents.en: For each search, the interface attempts to fetch the ranked results and returns an address for each stored page, along with any access failures.
sents.zh: 每次搜索时，接口都会尝试获取排序后的结果，并为每个已存储的页面返回一个地址，同时报告任何访问失败的情况。

sents.en: The agent can then search or read the compiled content without fetching the page again.
sents.zh: 之后，智能体无需再次获取页面，即可搜索或阅读已整理的内容。

sents.en: Browser tabs may also remain open, allowing the agent to return to a page and interact with it after inspecting other pages.
sents.zh: 浏览器标签页也可能保持打开状态，使智能体在检查其他页面后能够返回到某个页面并进行交互。

sents.en: These tabs share the browser session’s cookies and local storage, while each stored page state has its own address.
sents.zh: 这些标签页共享浏览器会话的 Cookie 和局部存储，而每个已存储页面的状态都有自己独立的地址。

paragraphs.en: After a control executes, the interface captures the resulting page. Navigation to another URL produces a page capture; an update at the same URL produces a state capture when the compiled content changes. For a state update, the response identifies the previous state and executed action, and lists changed, added, or removed files. An unchanged result creates no new state, and a previously reached state reuses its cached address. The action still executes even when its result is already cached.
paragraphs.zh: 控制执行后，接口会捕获生成的页面。 导航到另一个 URL 会产生页面捕获；在相同 URL 上进行更新时，如果编译后的内容发生变化，则会产生状态捕获。 对于状态更新，响应会识别之前的状态和已执行的操作，并列出已更改、新增或移除的文件。 未变化的结果不会创建新的状态，而之前已到达的状态则会重新使用其缓存的地址。 即使操作的结果已被缓存，该操作仍然会执行。

sents.en: After a control executes, the interface captures the resulting page.
sents.zh: 控制执行后，接口会捕获生成的页面。

sents.en: Navigation to another URL produces a page capture; an update at the same URL produces a state capture when the compiled content changes.
sents.zh: 导航到另一个 URL 会产生页面捕获；在相同 URL 上进行更新时，如果编译后的内容发生变化，则会产生状态捕获。

sents.en: For a state update, the response identifies the previous state and executed action, and lists changed, added, or removed files.
sents.zh: 对于状态更新，响应会识别之前的状态和已执行的操作，并列出已更改、新增或移除的文件。

sents.en: An unchanged result creates no new state, and a previously reached state reuses its cached address.
sents.zh: 未变化的结果不会创建新的状态，而之前已到达的状态则会重新使用其缓存的地址。

sents.en: The action still executes even when its result is already cached.
sents.zh: 即使操作的结果已被缓存，该操作仍然会执行。

paragraphs.en: As the agent navigates and interacts with a website, WebCache preserves previously visited page states so that earlier information remains available for reading. The stored addresses identify this information, but accessing them does not restore the browser to a previous state. To distinguish stored records from pages that remain open, list marks the most recently used live page as [active] and other retained live pages as [live] . After an interaction changes a page, its tab is associated with the resulting state, and focus selects a retained tab and returns its current state. Action execution depends on the browser state currently available. If a page must be reopened, the interface checks its current content before attempting the requested action. If the requested control cannot be confirmed, it returns the current page information without executing the action. If the tab for a saved interaction state is no longer available, the response explains that the action cannot be executed directly from that state.

paragraphs.en: We examine whether the overall gains are concentrated in particular domains. paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that inference costs respond differently as irrelevant pages accumulate, even though all three methods support selective reading. The trajectories suggest that this difference partly arises from how agents manage file paths as the workspace grows. Fetch-then-Explore typically starts with a full workspace listing, whose length increases with the number of stored pages. Hybrid SBF often avoids this step by passing the file path returned by fetch directly to grep . As more pages accumulate, however, keeping track of the relevant paths becomes more difficult, and we observe cases where incorrectly reproduced paths lead to full workspace listings. Web$hell provides short addresses for both pages and individual objects, helping agents specify subsequent searches and reads more reliably. These observations suggest that efficient selective access requires manageable references to stored content, so that locating evidence does not become increasingly costly as the workspace grows.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 显示，尽管三种方法都支持选择性读取，但随着无关页面的累积，推理成本的反应方式各不相同。 这些轨迹表明，这种差异部分源于智能体在workspace扩展时管理文件路径的方式。 “先获取再探索”策略通常从完整的workspace列表开始，其长度会随着已存储页面的数量增加而增长。 混合 SBF 策略通常通过直接将“获取”操作返回的文件路径传递给 grep，从而跳过这一步骤。 然而，随着更多页面的累积，追踪相关路径变得越来越困难，我们观察到一些因错误复现路径而导致完整workspace列表被调用的情况。 Web$hell 为页面和单个对象都提供了简短的地址，帮助智能体更可靠地指定后续搜索和读取操作。 这些观察结果表明，高效的选择性访问需要以可管理的方式引用已存储的内容，这样在workspace扩展时，定位证据的成本才不会持续增加。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 examines how Web$hell handles a growing collection of prefetched pages. By storing pages in WebCache and exposing them through selective operations, Web$hell makes more information available without requiring the agent to read every page. The agent inspects a similarly sized subset as the collection grows, with the fraction of cached pages inspected decreasing from 14.7% at k = 5 k=5 to 10.4% at k = 10 k=10 . Yet unaccessed content can still contain useful evidence. At k = 10 k=10 , 9.5% of the gold information in WebCache has not reached the agent’s observations. Retaining this content preserves the opportunity to retrieve it through later requests. This highlights the value of separating information availability from immediate consumption, while motivating cache management that preserves potentially useful evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 研究了 Web$hell 如何处理不断增长的预取页面集合。 通过将页面存储在 WebCache 中并通过选择性操作提供访问，Web$hell 无需智能体读取每一页即可使更多信息可用。 随着集合规模的扩大，智能体检查的子集大小保持相似，但所检查的缓存页面比例从 k = 5 时的 14.7% 下降至 k = 10 时的 10.4%。 然而，尚未访问的内容仍然可能包含有用证据。 在 k = 10 时，WebCache 中 9.5% 的黄金信息尚未进入智能体的观察范围。 保留这些内容可以确保后续请求仍有获取它们的机会。 这凸显了将信息可用性与即时使用区分开来的价值，同时为保留潜在有用证据的缓存管理提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: Web$hell and the main baselines share the same web-search API. However, page loading time depends heavily on the websites accessed and their rendering behavior, making total elapsed time an indirect measure of interface overhead. Web$hell also supports fallback access when retrieval fails and closes failed pages to avoid unnecessary continued processing. We therefore measure compilation overhead directly as the time required to compile acquired content and store the resulting objects. Across benchmarks, this takes 0.46–2.79 seconds per page on average (Table 7 ), indicating a modest per-page compilation cost.
paragraphs.zh: Web$hell 和主要基线模型共享相同的网页搜索 API。 然而，页面加载时间严重依赖于所访问的网站及其渲染行为，因此总耗时并不能直接反映接口开销。 当检索失败时，Web$hell 还支持回退访问，并关闭失败的页面以避免不必要的持续处理。 因此，我们将编译开销直接定义为获取内容并进行编译以及存储生成对象所需的时间。 在各个基准测试中，这一过程平均每页需要 0.46–2.79 秒（表 7），表明每页的编译成本相对较低。

paragraphs.en: Web$hell achieves higher performance than Fetch-then-Explore across Web Search and Deep Research with fewer model calls and comparable inference cost per task (Table 3 ). To understand this balance, we examine the cumulative token usage per task (Table 8 ). On Web Search, Web$hell uses fewer uncached input and output tokens, although its cached input is higher. The input totals include instructions explaining how to use each interface and its tool definitions. Under the evaluated pricing, cached input costs 10% of regular input, keeping the total inference cost comparable despite Web$hell ’s higher total token count. Thus, Web$hell achieves stronger information-seeking performance within a similar inference budget, while additionally supporting browser interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 在网页搜索和深度研究任务中，Web$hell 比 Fetch-then-Explore 性能更高，模型调用次数更少，且每任务的推理成本相当（表 3）。 为理解这种平衡关系，我们分析了每任务的累计令牌使用量（表 8）。 在网页搜索任务中，Web$hell 使用的未缓存输入和输出令牌更少，尽管其缓存输入量更高。 输入总量包括说明如何使用每个接口及其工具定义的指令。 根据所评估的定价方案，缓存输入的成本为常规输入的 10%，因此尽管 Web$hell 的总令牌数更高，其总推理成本仍保持相当。 因此，Web$hell 在相似的推理预算内实现了更强的信息获取性能，同时还支持浏览器交互。
